claims.statement: Large charcoal cartoon of the Virgin, Child, St Anne and St John. The date is disputed between the late Milan years and 1506 to 1508.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Stylistic dating; contested.
